en.title: Rooted Distances (Re-rooting DP)
en.description:
Given a tree and a weight a[v] for each vertex. The beauty of vertex v is the sum of dist(u,v)×a[u] over all vertices u. Output the maximum beauty over all vertices.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains n weights; the next n−1 lines give the edges u v (1-based). Constraints added by this site: 1≤n≤100000, 0≤a[i]≤10^9.
en.explanation: Root the tree at node 1 and first compute the weighted distance sum and the subtree weights; when the root moves from u to a child v, the subtree's contribution decreases and the rest increases, so re-rooting can be done in linear time.
